mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS 3-month growth > 0.5% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO 3-month decline > 1% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and starts rising, it signals the beginning of a tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and rising, but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.2M and UNRATE < 5%, but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this interaction signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS monthly increase > 200,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a stable or decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a healthy economic expansion without inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 3-month growth > 2% and FEDFUNDS stable or decreasing
failure_condition: If GDPC1 3-month growth > 2% and FEDFUNDS stable or decreasing, but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this interaction signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
